verdict.rationale: Ollama offers cloud API access with an API key, so a credential-scoping question fairly applies to it. However, the evidence only shows that a key exists. Nothing documents scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent credentials. A plain API key is an adjacent feature, not the scoped-credential capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
